task_statement: Add streaming serializer and signer APIs that can process values larger than memory while remaining compatible with every existing Serializer and Signer subclass. Treat this request as architecture discovery first; do not delegate implementation until public API, subclass, security, and compatibility decisions are fixed.
acceptance_criteria: architect identifies public API and subclass invariants
no bounded worker receives unresolved streaming/security design
the terminal outcome is a revised architecture plan or escalation
